rule.weights: tent 1-d/r, normalised per sample over allowed nodes in the sphere
rule.unmapped_rule: a sample with no allowed node inside the sphere is unmapped; never moved to a farther node
rule.ownership: node belongs to the face that assigned it the most area; ties to the smaller face index
rule.position_limit: search radius; |node centroid - CAD area centroid| <= r, |moment error| <= r*|F|
rule.moment_reference: CAD area centroid x requested force
